source: 2026-10-25 retained rocprofv3 traces, HIP graphs ON

L.boundary_method: The run.json server timing mark bounds one measured request in the same monotonic clock as rocprof Start_Timestamp/End_Timestamp. All complete GPU kernel dispatches inside that interval are summed and divided by the server-reported generated-token count. The final server eval-time row independently confirms the token count and wall ms/token. No per-token kernel boundary is inferred from kernel-name fingerprints.

prior_fingerprint_crosscheck.note: Fingerprint groups are retained only as a secondary cross-check; the server-marked interval is the primary measurement.

L.accounting: GPU kernel busy is summed End_Timestamp - Start_Timestamp divided by server-reported generated tokens. Request-window busy and per-token wall are distinct observables; their ratio is descriptive and does not assign host/GPU idle or overlap causes.
